Subject: Follow-up from today's trial review — procurement questions

Hi Olga / Monica,

Thanks for the demo and for walking us through the latency & cost controls. Quick recap from our procurement side after the internal sync:

- We need clarity on payment method: corporate card (one-time) vs PO / annual PR. Which is typical for customers your size?
- Does Redwood support standard marketplace purchase (we use the AWS Marketplace for small deals)?
- For a PO path, what does supplier onboarding look like in Coupa/Ariba? We have to create a supplier ID and map invoices to a PR number.
- Any required contract addenda for data handling / audit logs? Our legal team flagged SOC2 evidence.

Attached is our procurement questionnaire for Redwood to review. Can you confirm the minimal paperwork required and a rough timeline to get to a PO-able state?

Appreciate next steps — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Daniel

Head of Procurement | Acme Industries

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Brooks <d.brooks@acme-industries.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's trial review — procurement questions

Thanks Daniel — great questions and good context. Short answers up front, then proposed next steps and an attached PR template for Coupa:

1) Payment method
- Small pilot deals often use corporate card for fastest time-to-value. For production, most customers prefer PO-based billing with monthly invoices tied to a PR/PO. We support both.

2) Marketplace
- We do list in AWS Marketplace for select configurations; however, AWS Marketplace procurement still often requires an internal PO on your side. If you want to go marketplace, we can check eligibility for this deal and route procurement accordingly.

3) Coupa / Ariba onboarding
- Typical flow: you create a supplier record (we provide company legal name, tax ID, remit address). Once supplier ID exists, invoices reference the PR number and route through your AP flow.
- I've attached a Redwood PR template (Coupa-ready columns included) — fills for supplier name, Redwood supplier ID (TBD), remit-to info, and invoice contact.

4) Compliance / legal
- We can provide SOC 2 Type II attestation and the specific audit logs you requested (we keep audit logs for configurable retention windows). If you need a bespoke addendum, our legal team can draft.

Proposed next steps (my recommendation):
- I will open an internal procurement intake ticket to capture Redwood supplier details and request a supplier ID. (Sean is looped to help coordinate contract/commercial).
- Monica (CS) can provide usage estimates for the PO.
- If Acme prefers marketplace, confirm and we will validate listing eligibility.

Can you confirm which path you prefer (card pilot | PO with supplier ID | marketplace) and your target go-live date? If PO, please share your Coupa supplier intake form or confirm the fields we should send back.

Attaching: Redwood_PR_Template_Coupa.xlsx and Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW for commercial review).

Thanks — happy to run a 20-min call next week to close this out.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com | +1 650 555 0134
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — quick commercial note from my side.

Daniel, based on the sizing we discussed, here's what I'd propose:
- Pilot (1 month): corporate card preferred to unblock evaluation (no PO overhead).
- Production (quarterly/monthly invoicing): PO path with supplier ID and net-30 payment.

I will:
- Create deal record (HubSpot link below) and generate a draft order form.
- Kick off Redwood procurement intake ticket to request supplier onboarding and get a Redwood supplier ID for invoices. Ticket ref: TICKET-8891.
- Target timeline: supplier ID in Coupa within 5 business days after we provide legal name + remit details; draft order form in 2 business days.

If Acme is leaning marketplace, note that timeline can extend depending on marketplace approval flow — we can parallel-track it if you want.

Best,

- Tax ID / VAT: 94-1234567 (please confirm if you need W-9 instead)
- Remit-to address: 1400 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94103

Also please provide the Redwood supplier ID once the Coupa record is created and confirm invoice cadence and net terms.

We have attached a short internal Coupa intake form — I've filled what I can. If you want us to create the supplier record and then send you the supplier ID, we can do that.
